title: Sadhu Aur Shaitan
desc: Sher Khan robs a bank, frames Sadhuram, then dies. His body is found in Bajrang's taxi. Both Sadhuram and Bajrang run from police after being blamed.

title: Ajay
desc: Manorama falls in love with Ajay, even though they come from different social backgrounds. They want to get married, but Manorama's uncles try their best to separate the happy couple.

title: Sirf Tum
desc: Deepak and Aarti fall in love through letters without ever meeting or knowing each other's address. Longing to see him, Aarti finally travels to Delhi to search for her true love.

title: Khiladiyon Ka Khiladi
desc: Akshay joins Maya's gang while searching for his missing brother. To earn her trust, he must prove his strength and defeat his rival in a wrestling match.

title: The Kerala Story
desc: A former nursing student from Kerala becomes a terrorist's wife. She recounts her journey from innocence to radicalisation, revealing the dark truth behind her transformation.

title: Don - The Chase Begins Again
desc: Vijay, a lookalike of crime lord Don, is recruited to uncover his secrets. When the officer guiding him dies, Vijay is trapped in a deadly maze, struggling to prove his true identity.

title: Waris
desc: Disillusioned by the king's tyranny, the queen leaves with her son. Years later, upon the king's death, officials search for the heir to claim the throne.

title: Khoon Bhari Mang
desc: Widowed Aarti is trapped in Sanjay's devious marriage plot. With Nandini's help, he tries to drown her and steal her wealth, but she survives and rises to seek revenge.

title: Saudagar
desc: The friendship between Veeru and Rajeshwar turns into a bitter rivalry over time. Years later, they confront each other again when their grandchildren fall in love.

title: Dabangg
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, fights corruption his own way. Cheddi Singh creates a rift with his step-brother, exploiting it for power, forcing Chulbul to battle enemies inside and outside.

title: Ek Rishtaa: The Bond of Love
desc: Ajay's relationship with his powerful businessman father is strained, but when he discovers his brother-in-law's malicious plans, he rises to protect his family.

title: Sandwich
desc: Sher Singh juggles life with his two wives, Nisha and Sweety, but when they unexpectedly meet, his troubles multiply, leading to a series of hilarious situations.

title: Mr. India
desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Rajeev marries Roopa, a beautiful singer, but he struggles to accept her when he discovers her disfigured face, causing emotional pain and conflict in their relationship.

title: Chintu Ka Birthday
desc: An immigrant family in Iraq faces chaos when soldiers storm their home during a birthday celebration, exposing them to the harsh realities of conflict and fear.
